name: _dlopen_js
evidence: adapter.c load_lib / dl_open (the section 'the loader') + _host.py _dl_instantiate / _dl_scope / _dl_error. Probes on Pyodide 315.0.0a2 and on ours, both packagings, identical dlerror text for: missing file, relative name, empty file, 13-byte file, a file with no dylink first, a directory; ctypes.CDLL('/nonexistent.so') -> "could not load dynamic lib: /nonexistent.so\nError: Failed to find dynamic library \"/nonexistent.so\"". Differences that remain are the engine's own words for a module it rejects (CompileError / LinkError: wasmtime's reason, not V8's) and WAT text: a text file is refused with the glue's 'need to see wasm magic number'. Every offset of dylink.0, the imports and NEEDED is checked against the file (Rd in adapter.c); libraries and NEEDED depth are not limited (a vector; depth 512 against the native stack, then a dlerror); the GOT is first-definition-wins and a missing non-weak symbol fails the load as the glue does; env functions see the main module, RTLD_GLOBAL libraries, then the dlopen call's scope and the module's own exports; NEEDED: rpath ($ORIGIN) and LD_LIBRARY_PATH by the main module's _emscripten_find_dylib, then next to the module and /lib; side modules may import WASI. dlclose is the C library's in the glue as here (never unloads).

evidence: stub; caller is raise (func $14342); probe raise_signal SIGUSR1 -> ours [], real [10]; os.kill self -> ours silent, real 'handler 12'
tested: suite test_signal: RaiseSignalTest.test_handler and test_sigint FAIL on fused (run here)

name: _setitimer_js
gaps: A lie: the timer never fires. JS fires only from its event loop after the synchronous run, so the effect is the same inside one run. Python's signal module has no setitimer or alarm in this build (AttributeError in both), so only ctypes reaches it.
evidence: stub; callers setitimer (func $14439) and _emscripten_timeout; probe signal.setitimer -> AttributeError in both

evidence: not exported; probe: statvfs → ENOSYS / 4096

name: emscripten_get_heap_max
gaps: Reports 0x7FFF0000 (2 GiB - 64 KiB) while the memory actually grows to about 4 GiB (4000 MB allocated in both); JS reports 4294901760.
Not dlsym-visible in the dynamic flavor.
evidence: adapter.c:569; probe ctypes emscripten_get_heap_max -> ours 2147418112, real 4294901760; 40 x 100 MB bytearrays -> 4000 MB in both

name: _emscripten_system
gaps: It returns -1 instead of a -errno, so libc's __syscall_ret sets errno=1 (E2BIG). JS outside Node returns -52 (errno ENOSYS).
Real Pyodide on Node runs the command through a shell (os.system('echo hi') prints 'hi', returns 0) and system(NULL) gives 1. Ours returns -1 and 0, consistent with 'no processes'.
evidence: adapter.c:1463; probe: os.system('echo hi'), system(NULL), system(b'true') with use_errno -> ours -1/0/(-1, errno 1); real 0 + 'hi'/1/(0,0)

name: __syscall_bind
gaps: socket().bind(...) gives ENOSYS, so socket.socketpair() (its fallback uses bind/listen/accept) gives ENOSYS, and asyncio.run()/SelectorEventLoop() fail with OSError 52.

name: __syscall_connect
gaps: A non-blocking connect completes at once on the host (it can block there) and returns 0, never EINPROGRESS.
addrlen is ignored and the family is not checked against the socket.
evidence: adapter.c sc_connect, _host.py _n_connect

name: __syscall_getpeername
gaps: Always an AF_INET sockaddr. For an AF_INET6 socket the host's socket.inet_aton(ip) is outside the try (_host.py:412) and would raise in the host function, i.e. a trap (not verified: the host here has no IPv6).
*lenp is read without a NULL check.
evidence: adapter.c:1204-1222; probe: unconnected → ENOTCONN; connected → ('127.0.0.1', 47811)

name: __syscall_getsockname
gaps: Always AF_INET; IPv6 has the same suspected host trap as getpeername (not verified).
evidence: adapter.c:1223-1226; probe: unconnected ('0.0.0.0',0), connected 127.0.0.1

name: __syscall_getsockopt
gaps: Every option returns 0 with success (a lie): SO_RCVBUF 0; TCP_NODELAY 0 right after setting it to 1. Pyodide's JS gives ENOPROTOOPT for everything but SO_ERROR.
SO_TYPE is always SOCK_STREAM, even for UDP sockets.
If *optlen < 4 it returns 0 and writes nothing.
evidence: adapter.c:1228-1234; probe: SO_TYPE tcp 1, udp 1; SO_RCVBUF 0; TCP_NODELAY (None, 0); SO_ERROR 0

name: __syscall_listen
gaps: No server sockets (Pyodide on Node: fatal without `ws`).
evidence: not exported; probe: listen → ENOSYS

name: __syscall_recvfrom
gaps: The source address is never written: on UDP, recvfrom gives no sender.
Only MSG_PEEK and MSG_DONTWAIT are honoured (MSG_WAITALL etc. ignored).
evidence: adapter.c sc_recvfrom: EAGAIN for a non-blocking socket or MSG_DONTWAIT without data (net.poll with timeout 0)

name: __syscall_recvmsg
gaps: Only the first non-empty iovec is filled (recvmsg_into with several buffers fills one).
msg_name is not written (no sender address).
evidence: adapter.c sc_recvmsg: msg_controllen and msg_namelen are zeroed, ENOTSOCK is 57, EAGAIN as recvfrom

name: __syscall_sendmsg
gaps: msg_name is ignored; control data (SCM_RIGHTS) is dropped silently.
Each iovec is a separate host send.
evidence: adapter.c sc_sendmsg: ENOTSOCK is 57, EAGAIN as sendto

name: __syscall_sendto
gaps: The destination address is ignored: sendto on an unconnected UDP socket gives EDESTADDRREQ.
flags other than MSG_DONTWAIT are ignored (MSG_OOB is sent in-band).
evidence: adapter.c sc_sendto: EAGAIN when a non-blocking socket cannot take data
tested: tests/test_sockets.py (send path through the peer fixture)

name: __syscall_shutdown
evidence: adapter.c:1198-1202; probe: shutdown(SHUT_WR) then recv → b'Eq', b'' (Linux semantics; Pyodide's JS returns ENOSYS, so ours does more); non-socket → ENOTSOCK

name: __syscall_socket
gaps: protocol is ignored; SOCK_RAW gives EAFNOSUPPORT instead of EPROTONOSUPPORT/EPERM.
At most MAXFD (1024) descriptors in all: a socket needs a free one (EMFILE).
AF_INET6 depends on the host and then meets the IPv4-only getsockname/getpeername.
evidence: adapter.c sc_socket (a placeholder WASI descriptor, SOCK_NONBLOCK kept); the audit's earlier gaps (fd >= 4096, SOCK_NONBLOCK dropped) are fixed
